REFERENCE
The foundations
Type, radius and control height, read from the tokens and Tailwind's scale. Colour is on grounds and site.
Type
Tailwind's steps, as the components set them. Size / line height in px.
text-3xl 30 / 36 Says what it does An entity's title, from md up
text-2xl 24 / 32 Says what it does An entity's title; a section heading from md
text-xl 20 / 28 Says what it does A section heading; a working page's title
text-lg 18 / 28 Says what it does A tile, form section or empty state title from md; a dialog title
text-base 16 / 24 Says what it does A tile or form section title
text-sm 14 / 20 Says what it does Body, subtitles and controls
text-xs 12 / 16 Says what it does Eyebrows, meta and badges
sans Inter Variable: labels, body and controls brand Plus Jakarta Sans Variable display face; Inter under warm and navy mono JetBrains Mono · text-mono 12 px: ids, paths, keys
Radius
A closed scale of three. Tailwind's rounded-xs to -md are control, -lg to -4xl panel.
--vg-radius-control 6 px Buttons, fields, menu items
--vg-radius-panel 10 px Cards, dialogs, popovers, every bento surface
--vg-radius-full Full Pills, avatars, the state dot
Control height
Two heights and a touch step. Every control reads these, never a fixed h-*.
Field at 32 px --vg-control-dense Tables, filter bars, toolbars: sm and icon-sm · 44 px on touch
Field at 36 px --vg-control-form Fields and their actions: default, lg, icon · 44 px on touch
Field at 44 px --vg-control-touch Both, under pointer: coarse
